source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Whenever the destruction of one of your **ADEPTA SORORITAS** units or models no more than 12″ from this model earns you a [Miracle dice](vsdata:ability/adepta-sororitas.acts-of-faith), you may re-roll that dice before putting it in your Miracle Dice pool.

ability.trigger: you gain a Miracle dice because an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit or model from your army was destroyed

effect.timing: before adding it to your Miracle Dice pool
